quarterly_data.quarter: FiberHome Telecommunication annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 revenue by product (annual report): communication system equipment RMB 18,654,767,364.94, down 16.40%, gross margin 18.81%; optical fiber and cable RMB 4,654,097,601.94, down 0.95%, gross margin 25.17%; data network products RMB 1,419,618,980.01, up 24.05%, gross margin 39.28%. Domestic revenue RMB 16,735,208,068.46 (-16.97%, gross margin 19.30%); overseas RMB 7,993,275,878.43 (-0.09%, gross margin 25.14%). Company: cost of sales fell 12.55%, mainly on lower shipments of traditional products, while a phased rise in storage-type material prices kept the cost decline slightly below the revenue decline.

quarterly_data.quarter: FiberHome Telecommunication annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 business review (annual report): domestic revenue was under pressure as operator investment kept falling; fiber and cable stayed in the first tier and OTN / PON share stabilised and recovered; servers kept a leading position with operators and finance customers and achieved a scale breakthrough with internet customers; DCI product revenue grew year on year. Internationally revenue stopped falling, several large multinational operator customers were added, pre-connectorized product sales rose into the global front ranks, and the Thailand and Hungary R&D and manufacturing bases entered volume production (company: easing the impact of trade barriers).

quarterly_data.quarter: FiberHome Telecommunication annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 technology results (annual report): with China Mobile it completed what it calls the industry-first verification of a 1.6T dual-carrier, FlexO large-granularity electrical cross-connect OTN prototype system; launched 50G PON products based on self-developed chips; low-loss hollow-core fiber reached a 0.063dB/km ultra-low attenuation record; self-developed full liquid-cooled rack supercomputing product reaches 120TFLOPS double-precision per node; launched a DeepSeek all-in-one appliance covering 1.5B-670B model parameters.

quarterly_data.quarter: FiberHome Telecommunication annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Construction in progress at end-2025 (annual report): RMB 1,364,806,787.62 (RMB 889,892,642.52 a year earlier). Major projects: 5G bearer application and digital economy R&D and production base, budget RMB 1,887,590,000.00, 45.19% of budget invested; East China headquarters base phase 1 (Nanjing), budget RMB 1,015,401,000.00, 40.22% invested - the company says both are about to be put into use; construction of a multimode and special optical fiber smart manufacturing factory has started; CIP also lists Phase 5 and Phase 6 PCVD expansion projects and the Thailand optical cable factory. Raised-fund projects: the FiberHome Ruituo optical fiber preform project (phase 1, RMB 50,000 ten-thousand planned, 96.15% invested) and the next-generation broadband access system equipment project reached usable status in 2025-12.

quarterly_data.quarter: FiberHome Telecommunication annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report, company guidance, no figures): theme 'deepen reform, incremental development', aiming to keep growing scale; in the domestic operator market strengthen optical network products through centralized procurement and keep its server position while advancing liquid-cooled servers; in the internet industry expand product categories and keep scaling; R&D to focus on overall optical-connection solutions for AI and intelligent computing centers, 'three-ultra' optical communication, 6G and marine optical communication, plus satellite and automotive optical communication. For the 15th Five-Year Plan it will focus on three core industries: active optical communication, passive optical communication and computing power.
